description: Real repositories used only for scan-time measurement. Never accuracy-scored: they carry no ground truth, and timing the accuracy fixtures would measure a few thousand lines and say nothing about a production repository.
buckets: Bucket names are MEASURED, not intended. The first labels were estimates and every one of them was wrong — commons-lang was guessed at 50k and is 130k, spring-boot at 200k and is 642k. Against the service levels that matter (under 3 minutes at 50-200k LOC, under 10 minutes past 500k) commons-lang sits inside the pull-request band and spring-boot past the large-repo threshold; hadoop is an extreme rather than a representative case.

sources.name: commons-cli
sources.notes: Smallest bucket: establishes fixed overhead — process start, rule compilation — that a large-repo number hides.
